big_case.notes: Quiet-title dispute over a single spoil island off Key West between a private corporation and the United States. The questions presented ask the Court to revisit Anderson v. City of Bessemer City's clear-error rule for documentary findings, a point settled in 1985 and uniformly followed; the decision below is an unpublished per curiam. The government waived its response, nobody filed as amicus, and the petition was denied at its first conference with no noted dissent. Local salience only; no doctrinal movement.
